class.name: TimerServer

method.name: create_timer
method.description: Creates a [TimerInstance] from [param info] and returns it. The instance is stopped; call [method TimerInstance.start] to run it. A running instance is kept alive by the server, so [code]await TimerServer.create_timer(info).timeout[/code] works after [method TimerInstance.start] was called on it.

method.name: format_time
method.description: Formats [param seconds] with the placeholders [code]{h}[/code], [code]{hh}[/code], [code]{m}[/code], [code]{mm}[/code], [code]{s}[/code], [code]{ss}[/code], [code]{ds}[/code], [code]{cs}[/code] and [code]{ms}[/code] ([code]hh[/code], [code]mm[/code], [code]ss[/code], [code]cs[/code] and [code]ms[/code] are zero-padded; [code]ds[/code], [code]cs[/code] and [code]ms[/code] are tenths, hundredths and thousandths of a second). The largest unit in [param format] carries the full amount, so [code]"{mm}:{ss}"[/code] shows [code]75:03[/code] for 4503 seconds. If [param round_up] is [code]true[/code], the value is rounded up to the smallest unit in the format, as a countdown display expects.

method.name: free_rid
method.description: Frees [param timer]. Emits [signal timer_unregistered]. [Timer] nodes and [TimerInstance]s free their timers themselves.

method.name: get_timer
method.description: Returns the first timer with the name [param name], or an invalid [RID] if there is none. [Timer] nodes use their node name unless [member TimerInfo.timer_name] is set.

method.name: get_timer_count
method.description: Returns the number of timers.

method.name: get_timers
method.description: Returns the [RID]s of all timers, including those of [Timer] nodes and [TimerInstance]s.

method.name: pause_all
method.description: Pauses every running timer. The timers emit their [code]pause_changed[/code] signal and report [method timer_is_paused] as [code]true[/code]. Timers that are not running are not paused. See also [method resume_all].

method.name: resume_all
method.description: Resumes every paused timer. See also [method pause_all].

method.name: stop_all
method.description: Stops every timer, as if [method timer_stop] was called on each of them. The timers emit their [code]stopped[/code] signal.

method.name: timer_add_time
method.description: Adds [param time_sec] to the shown time of [param timer] (time left for a countdown, elapsed time for a stopwatch). Use a negative value to remove time.

method.name: timer_create
method.description: Creates a stopped timer and returns its [RID]. Emits [signal timer_registered]. Free it with [method free_rid].

method.name: timer_get_current_time
method.description: Returns the shown time of [param timer]: the time left for a countdown (always [code]0.0[/code] while stopped), the elapsed time for a stopwatch.

method.name: timer_get_elapsed_time
method.description: Returns the time that has passed since [param timer] was started, in seconds, scaled by its time scale.

method.name: timer_get_name
method.description: Returns the name of [param timer].

method.name: timer_get_object
method.description: Returns the object set with [method timer_set_object], or [code]null[/code] if there is none or it was freed.

method.name: timer_get_tick_mode
method.description: Returns the tick mode of [param timer].

method.name: timer_get_time_left
method.description: Returns the time until [param timer] ends, in seconds. This is [code]0.0[/code] if the timer is stopped or a stopwatch without a total time.

method.name: timer_get_total_time
method.description: Returns the total time of [param timer].

method.name: timer_is_loop
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param timer] restarts after it ended.

method.name: timer_is_paused
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param timer] is paused.

method.name: timer_is_running
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param timer] was started and has not ended or been stopped. A paused timer is still running.

method.name: timer_is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param timer] is a timer of this server.

method.name: timer_set_alerts
method.description: Sets the alerts of [param timer], in shown time: the time left for a countdown, the elapsed time for a stopwatch. Each alert emits an alert event once per run.

method.name: timer_set_callback
method.description: Sets the callable that receives the events of [param timer]. It is called with the event ([enum TimerEvent]) and the shown time as arguments, only when something happens. Per frame and timer the order is alerts, tick, timeout.

method.name: timer_set_current_time
method.description: Sets the shown time of [param timer]. A countdown may get more time left than its total time; a stopwatch does not go below zero.

method.name: timer_set_ignore_time_scale
method.description: If [param ignore] is [code]true[/code], [param timer] ignores [member Engine.time_scale].

method.name: timer_set_info
method.description: Applies all values of [param info] to [param timer]. If [param include_clock] is [code]false[/code], [member TimerInfo.process_mode] is not applied; [Timer] nodes use this because they follow [member Node.process_mode].

method.name: timer_set_loop
method.description: If [param enable] is [code]true[/code], [param timer] restarts when it ends, carrying over the remainder of the frame.

method.name: timer_set_name
method.description: Sets the name of [param timer], used by [method get_timer].

method.name: timer_set_object
method.description: Sets the object that owns [param timer]. If it is a [RefCounted], the server keeps it alive while the timer is running.

method.name: timer_set_paused
method.description: Pauses or resumes [param timer] and emits the matching event.

method.name: timer_set_process_always
method.description: If [param enable] is [code]true[/code], [param timer] keeps running while the [SceneTree] is paused.

method.name: timer_set_process_in_physics
method.description: If [param enable] is [code]true[/code], [param timer] is updated every physics frame instead of every process frame.

method.name: timer_set_suspended
method.description: Suspends or unsuspends [param timer] without changing its paused state. [Timer] nodes use this while they cannot process (outside the tree, [member Node.process_mode], tree pause).

method.name: timer_set_tick_interval
method.description: Sets the interval of the tick events of [param timer]. [code]0[/code] disables ticks.

method.name: timer_set_tick_mode
method.description: Sets the tick mode of [param timer].

method.name: timer_set_time_scale
method.description: Sets the speed of [param timer] relative to its clock. [code]2.0[/code] runs twice as fast.

method.name: timer_set_total_time
method.description: Sets the total time of [param timer], in seconds. For a stopwatch, [code]0[/code] means it has no end.

method.name: timer_start
method.description: Starts [param timer] from the beginning and emits the started event.

method.name: timer_stop
method.description: Stops [param timer] and emits the stopped event. This does not emit a timeout.

signal.name: timer_registered
signal.description: Emitted when a timer is created.

signal.name: timer_unregistered
signal.description: Emitted when a timer is freed.

constants.constant: The timer was started. The shown time is the one at the start.
A tick interval has passed. The shown time is passed along.
An alert time was reached. The alert time is passed along.
The timer reached its end. At most one timeout is emitted per timer and frame.
